title: Check domain availability
summary: Search domains and check availability across TLDs.

parts.title: Check registrar availability across TLDs
parts.guidance: Search the candidate names and required extensions at registrars that support them. Distinguish available registrations from resale listings, unavailable names and unsupported extensions. Capture the exact spelling, displayed price and observation time, then recheck ambiguous results with the registrar that would handle the purchase. Return the viable choices and restrictions for the cost comparison.

execution.rationale: The supported path for “Check registrar availability across TLDs” is a person working through the stated digital records, service or communication channel. Retain the named owners, approvals and expert review. This classification does not claim a verified agent integration or imply that future automation is impossible.

parts.title: Check matching social handles
parts.guidance: Check exact handles on the company's intended social channels and link the profiles found. Check platform availability even when the existing profile appears inactive. Where names are taken, compare recognizable alternatives that work consistently across the priority channels.

execution.rationale: The supported path for “Check matching social handles” is a person working through the stated digital records, service or communication channel. Retain the named owners, approvals and expert review. This classification does not claim a verified agent integration or imply that future automation is impossible.

parts.title: Shortlist candidates with pricing and renewal costs
parts.guidance: Compare each shortlisted domain's registrar, registration term, initial price, renewal price, currency, extras and any resale quote. Use current renewal and transfer terms to calculate the ongoing cost after any introductory discount. Recommend a domain and registrar with the exact spending requirement, company ownership arrangement and person responsible for renewals.

execution.rationale: The supported path for “Shortlist candidates with pricing and renewal costs” is a person working through the stated digital records, service or communication channel. Retain the named owners, approvals and expert review. This classification does not claim a verified agent integration or imply that future automation is impossible.
